title: A bit off the top
html_source: A phrase usually applied to a trim haircut at the barber’s, but here a playful reference to circumcision.

anchor.prefix:
bob a week said he had a farm in the county Down off a hop-of-my-thumb by the name of Moses Herzog over there near Heytesbury street. 

 — Circumcised? says Joe. 

 — Ay, says I.
anchor.suffix:
. An old plumber named Geraghty. I'm hanging on to his taw now for the past fortnight and I can't get a penny out of him. 

 — That the lay you're on now? says Joe. 

 — Ay, says I
